[spoiler=[i][b]Peuple d'une étoile mourantes[/b][/i]]
Thousands gather at the city block, awaiting a speech. But the podium remains empty. Their expressions speak volumes, faces etched with hopelessness, defeat, and despair. The pride of their nation has fallen, and with it, the spirit of its people.

Under the starlit sky, as the wind carries the Starborn banner high, the General Director steps forward. His battle dress is adorned with glinting stars and medals of valor. Cameras flash furiously. Interviewers surge forward like ravenous beasts, but he pays them no mind. Instead, his gaze fixes on the weary crowd. He touches the mic once, and begins to speak:

[i]O' Great People of the Stars,

Our once-renowned nation has endured the gravest trial in its history. From across the seas, foreign barbarians have raided our lands, slaughtered our people, and treated us as little more than cattle. We have fought to preserve our sovereignty, and suffered deeply for it.

We were once the shining jewel of Elesyr. But now, we are battered by enemies, betrayed by cowards, and deceived by false prophets. Yet in our darkest hour, God has not abandoned us. This struggle, this pain, is not punishment. It is a trial. A divine test to see if we are worthy of the stars. And we have endured.

We have succeeded.

God has marked out a new path for us: to reclaim our destiny, to inherit the lands of Elesyr once more. He will guide our hand in this endeavor. And so, we must follow.

His first command leads us to Nestor-Sikirsk,a former CORE territory of the Gendarme, stolen from us in our moment of weakness. It is time we take back what is rightfully ours, and raise it above our heads with pride, as we once did.

I do not ask you to fight. I ask you to contribute, to stand tall, give what you can, and be remembered by the generations that follow. Let history speak of your courage, your resolve, and your unwavering loyalty.

DIEU EST AVEC LE GENDARME,
NOUS SOMMES STARBORN.[/i]
 [/spoiler]
